text.tspan: Selected federal versus municipal election voter turnout rates
Data sources: Elections Canada (2025); Association of Municipalities of Ontario, 2026 Ontario Municipal Elections (unofficial);
City of Vancouver (2026); City of Winnipeg (2026); City of Yellowknife (2026).
*Federal election voter turnout was calculated as the weighted average voter turnout for all federal electoral districts within
Results from the 2025 federal election and 2026 municipal elections
